react_result.final_narrative_text: Cross-paradigm analysis of nine differentially abundant metabolites reveals a dominant and highly consistent signal around arachidonic acid metabolism and eicosanoid biosynthesis. All three pathway-analysis paradigms converge on this network as the top-ranked hit: RaMP multi-database ORA returned 'Eicosanoid synthesis' (WP:WP167) at rank 1 with FDR=1.39×10⁻¹² and a fold-enrichment of 1250.9, driven by five input metabolites (5-HETE, 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-PGJ₂, 15-HETE, arachidonic acid, and leukotriene A₄). Mummichog's m/z-direct search identified 'Arachidonic acid metabolism' (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism) as its top hit (p=0.0063) and 'Prostaglandin formation from arachidonate' as rank 4 (p=0.034), with full overlap of 11 and 6 compounds respectively against the input set. MetaboAnalystR's KEGG-specific PSEA also returned KEGG:hsa00590 (arachidonic acid metabolism) as the top pathway, capturing arachidonic acid, leukotriene A₄, 15-HETE, and 5-HETE. InChIKey reconciliation confirmed all five eicosanoid compounds are structurally distinct (five unique first-block codes), ruling out any namespace artefact. No other pathway recurred across two independent paradigms; glycerophospholipid metabolism (MUMM:glycerophospholipid_metabolism) appeared only in mummichog, and purine metabolism (hsa00983) only in single-hit PSEA. The biological story is one of robust phospholipase-A₂-mediated release of arachidonic acid from membrane stores followed by convergent oxidation along 5-lipoxygenase (5-HETE, leukotriene A₄) and cyclooxygenase / prostaglandin J₂ branches (15-HETE, 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-PGJ₂), consistent with an inflammatory or bioactive-lipid-active treatment. L-serine, methylmalonic acid, dehydroascorbic acid, and 6-methylthiopurine did not cluster with the eicosanoid core but may reflect secondary perturbations in one-carbon metabolism (serine) or thiol biochemistry (6-methylthiopurine).

react_result.final_narrative_text: Three complementary pathway-analysis paradigms identified eicosanoid and arachidonic acid metabolism as the dominant biological signal in the nine-metabolite differential set. RaMP-DB multi-DB ORA returned WP:WP167 (Eicosanoid synthesis) as the top hit with FDR = 1.39e-12, capturing five input metabolites: 5-HETE, 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-prostaglandin J2, 15-HETE, arachidonic acid, and leukotriene A4. Mummichog's m/z-direct search returned MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism as its top result with p = 0.0076 and achieved 11-of-11 compound overlap against its reference library. MetaboAnalystR's KEGG-specific PSEA returned KEGG:hsa00590 as its top result and captured arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 15-HETE, and 5-HETE. The five eicosanoid metabolites are structurally distinct based on their InChIKey first blocks, ruling out namespace artefact as an explanation for the convergence. Arachidonic acid is the shared substrate linking all three pathway hits: it is the direct precursor for prostaglandin J2 formation, the upstream source for leukotriene A4 via 5-lipoxygenase, and the parent compound whose oxidation yields both 5-HETE and 15-HETE through distinct lipoxygenase pathways. Methylmalonic acid, L-serine, dehydroascorbic acid, and 6-methylmercaptopurine did not map to the eicosanoid core in any of the three enrichment analyses.

RaMP-DB multi-DB ORA returned WP:WP167 (Eicosanoid synthesis) as the top hit with FDR = 1.39e-12, capturing five input metabolites: 5-HETE, 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-prostaglandin J2, 15-HETE, arachidonic acid, and leukotriene A4. Mummichog's m/z-direct search returned MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism as its top result with p = 0.0076 and achieved 11-of-11 compound overlap against its reference library. MetaboAnalystR's KEGG-specific PSEA returned KEGG:hsa00590 as its top result and captured arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 15-HETE, and 5-HETE. The five eicosanoid metabolites are structurally distinct based on their InChIKey first blocks, ruling out namespace artefact as an explanation for the convergence. Arachidonic acid is the shared substrate linking all three pathway hits: it is the direct precursor for prostaglandin J2 formation, the upstream source for leukotriene A4 via 5-lipoxygenase, and the parent compound whose oxidation yields both 5-HETE and 15-HETE through distinct lipoxygenase pathways. Methylmalonic acid, L-serine, dehydroascorbic acid, and 6-methylmercaptopurine did not map to the eicosanoid core in any of the three enrichment analyses.
